snippet.title: Magicians: The Devil's Deal - Reveal Trailer | XBOX Games Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Step into illusion. Claim your power. 🎩
Magicians: The Devil’s Deal is revealed at XBOX Games Showcase!
🃏 Become the ultimate trickster
🔥 Turn stage magic into deadly powers
🎭 Explore the twisted realms of Theatreland
⚡ Defeat the Masters and claim their abilities

Magicians: The Devil’s Deal is coming to XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC as an XBOX Play Anywhere title and with XBOX Game Pass.
